title: Test helper swallows file-read/catalog-load errors and discards node_type_index oks — zeroed catalog reaches unchecked cat.node_types[type_idx] index
detail: Errors are printed then swallowed and lookup oks discarded; a zeroed/partial catalog flows into topology_spawn_node's unchecked cat.node_types[type_idx] — OOB panic on empty, vacuous passes on partial loads.
recommended_fix: Fail the test on any read or catalog-load error (testing.failf); check node_type_index's ok and abort with a named message instead of discarding it.
